cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Put yesterday's missing hour in this jar before lunch. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then loosen the lid. Don't make the opening smaller than necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm labelling. We mustn't confuse it with tomorrow.
